'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Rick Zuchowski LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rick Zuchowski]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Rick Zuchowski]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|Dantooine Base Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
